response.sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, (SELECT AVG(t.amount) FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')) AS avg_amt, (SELECT AVG(t2.balance) FROM trans t2 WHERE t2.account_id = a.account_id) AS avg_bal FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS amount_avg, AVG(avg_bal) AS balance_avg FROM acct GROUP BY region), mean_amt AS (SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS m FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.amount_avg, r.balance_avg, r.amount_avg / m.m AS amount_avg_ratio FROM reg r CROSS JOIN mean_amt m WHERE m.m IS NOT NULL AND m.m <> 0;
